title: Content Expansion Pack 001
mission: Fill weak Matrix Reprogrammed investigation areas with public-record content, source routes, boundaries, pressure points and next pulls.
boundary: This pack uses public-record and public-source routes. Sensitive Epstein material is linked, not reproduced. WikiLeaks material is treated as a leak/cross-reference lane, not as a primary Epstein case file unless tied to official court, DOJ, House, FOIA or authenticated records. Association, appearance in a file, email mention, flight record, photograph, invitation or source-map node is not proof of wrongdoing.

sourcePolicy.use: DOJ Epstein Library, DOJ Disclosures, House Oversight releases, court dockets, FOIA pages, regulator records, SEC/IRS filings.
Complaints show allegations; orders/findings show court action; settlements require no-admission language to be stated if present.

sourcePolicy.grade: C unless authenticated and directly relevant
sourcePolicy.use: Use as a cross-reference for public communications and influence context only. Do not treat leaked emails as proof of Epstein file content or wrongdoing by themselves.
Use Jmail/EpsteinExposed-style indexes for discovery only, then pull the underlying official record before upgrading.
Link to official route or mark missing/manual-review. Do not reproduce raw explicit material, victim identifiers, private addresses, family/minor data or private live movement data.

areas.title: Political Access Lane
areas.summary: Tracks political access, invitations, donations, public statements, congressional subpoenas, testimony, denials and public responses without turning political proximity into guilt.
confirmedContent: DOJ and House routes create official source lanes for Epstein-related records.
Court-record and disclosure pages include political/reputation context only when file-level records support it.
Public testimony or denials must be stored as response cards, not ignored.
openQuestions: Which political figures appear in official records, and in what exact document type?
Which references are direct communications, third-party mentions, guest lists, photos, flight records, donations or speculation?
Which public denials or sworn testimony exist and need to be attached?
nextPulls: Create public response cards for Clinton, Trump, Mandelson, Dershowitz and other recurring public figures only where public records/reporting justify it.
Use WikiLeaks political-email archives only as a cross-reference lane; verify every Epstein-specific claim through DOJ/House/court records.

areas.title: Academic / Foundation Network
areas.summary: Tracks universities, science funding, elite philanthropy, foundation money, institutional prestige and reputation-repair routes.
confirmedContent: Tracker Core already contains foundation and philanthropy lanes.
IRS Form 990, university reviews, grant records and public statements are the correct source route for this lane.
Institutional funding is not wrongdoing unless a record shows improper action, concealment, compliance failure or official finding.
openQuestions: Which institutions received money, hosted Epstein-linked events, gave titles/access, or issued later reviews?
Which grants or donations were returned, renamed, reviewed or publicly addressed?
Which records are just philanthropic/public prestige context versus actual misconduct findings?
nextPulls: Create Form 990 / grant-record cards for foundation lanes.
Create institutional review cards for universities and science funding lanes.
Create public statement cards for every institution.

areas.title: Transport / Logistics Lane
areas.summary: Tracks historical transport records, flight-log exhibits, CBP/FOIA routes, registry context and movement records without live tracking or passenger speculation.
confirmedContent: DOJ FOIA category routes include CBP, FBI, BOP and Florida lanes.
The site already has an Aviation Evidence Policy that bars live personal movement tracking and unsupported passenger identity inference.
openQuestions: Which flight or transport records are court exhibits, FOIA records, logs, registry context or third-party claims?
Which records identify passengers versus aircraft/entity ownership only?
Which records are privacy-blocked or unsafe to quote?
nextPulls: Link to historical flight-log source routes rather than live trackers for personal movement.
Create transport evidence cards only from official records or court exhibits.

areas.title: Reputation Laundering / Media Silence Lane
areas.summary: Tracks reputation repair, PR, media access, Wikipedia/editing attempts, elite events, photos, cultural proximity and institutional silence.
confirmedContent: The release-machine lane already captures search limits, fake-material warnings and redaction problems.
Public reporting indicates reputational-management themes exist in released Epstein communications; the site must link to records/reporting rather than reproduce sensitive emails.
openQuestions: Which communications show reputation repair attempts?
Which media/cultural contacts were event invitations, personal friendships, business context or third-party mentions?
Which claims are debunked or unsupported viral interpretations?
nextPulls: Create reputation-repair source cards from safe public reporting and official archive routes.
Add fake/false-submission downgrade queue for viral claims.
Create public-response/correction cards for named figures.

areas.title: Leak / Public Record Protocol
areas.summary: Defines how the site treats WikiLeaks, leaked emails, public archive mirrors, DOJ files, House releases and court records.
confirmedContent: DOJ library and disclosure pages are official source routes.
WikiLeaks is a separate leak archive, mostly relevant as a political-email cross-reference rather than as the main Epstein file repository.
Unofficial indexes can help discovery but cannot upgrade claims without the underlying record.
openQuestions: Which leaked materials overlap with official public records?
Which leaks contain private data that should be linked rather than reproduced?
Which records have been authenticated, denied, corrected or superseded?
nextPulls: Create Source Policy page that grades DOJ/House/court/FOIA/WikiLeaks/DDoSecrets/Jmail-style routes separately.
Add leak-source warning to all pages using leaked material.
Create a correction/downgrade lane for fake submissions and unverifiable leaks.
